newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish far-right nationalists chose new leader.
newsitem.headline: Turkish far-right nationalists chose new leader.

text.p: The Turkish far-right National Action Party chose a new leader on Sunday after the death of its veteran chieftain, Alparslan Turkes, in April, state-run Anatolian news agency said.

Devlet Bahceli was elected ahead of Turkes' son and heir apparent Tugrul Turkes in a party congress held in Ankara after a similar meeting was abandonned in May when fist-fighting broke out between rival factions.

Bahceli and the party's "Grey Wolf" nationalists who espouse unity between Turkic-speaking peoples, failed to win any seats in parliament at the last election in 1995, but gained two MPs after defections from Tansu Ciller's True Path Party last month.
